summary: Implemented and exported `Perc`, added API documentation and release notes, and added tests for percentile counts, explicit levels, method handling, grouping, missing data, and `Plot.add`. The focused statistics tests passed (34 passed). The full suite had 1,783 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed; one unrelated existing failure was `TestFacetGrid.test_subplot_kws`, which expected the old Matplotlib class name `PolarAxesSubplot` but received `PolarAxes`.
